## Part 1


```{r}

look_and_say <- function(line) {
  str_split_1(line, '') |>
    rle() -> tmp
  fst <- as.character(tmp$lengths)
  sec <- tmp$values
  res <- as.vector(rbind(fst, sec))
  paste(res, collapse = '')
}
look_and_say("111221")
look_and_say("1211")
```


```{r}
input <- "3113322113"

counter <- 0
while (counter < 40) {
  input <- look_and_say(input)
  counter <- counter + 1L
}
nchar(input)
```

429204 too high

329356


## Part 2


```{r}
input <- "3113322113"

counter <- 0
len <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = 50)
len[1] <- nchar(input)
while (counter < 50) {
  input <- look_and_say(input)
  counter <- counter + 1L
  len[counter + 1] <- nchar(input)
}
nchar(input)
```


4666278




```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 6
tibble(lg = len, x = seq_along(len)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, lg)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "iteration", y = "length")
```
